purpose: personal account of Alexey building AuTomator and repairing it with Claude Code

required_facts.fact: The DataTalks.Club community had more than 88,000 people across many Slack channels.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 3: community scale and Slack distribution are stated.

required_facts.fact: Manual moderation of shameless-promotion channels required deleting rule-breaking messages and sending explanatory DMs.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 5-7: rules, manual actions, and motivation for automation are described.

required_facts.fact: AuTomator was built in June 2022 and continued to gain features as new needs appeared.
required_facts.evidence: Source line 12: origin date and continuing feature work are stated.

required_facts.fact: AuTomator runs as an AWS Lambda backend split into three Lambdas.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 19-21: runtime and three-part architecture are specified.

required_facts.fact: The router checks whether an admin added a reaction and stays lightweight because Slack requires rapid event acknowledgement.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 25-27: routing condition and timeout reason are described.

required_facts.fact: The automator maps configured emoji reactions in YAML to actions such as deleting, reposting, or generating an AI reply.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 31-37: YAML mapping and reaction actions are listed.

required_facts.fact: The moderator Lambda was implemented with GitHub Copilot but had not been deployed and still needed real-world testing.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 41-45: moderator status, purpose, and actions are stated.

required_facts.fact: Claude Code was asked to inspect the previous two hours of logs after a reaction failed to delete a message.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 49-60: failure, context, and diagnostic request are described.

required_facts.fact: The repair found a missing GROQ_API_KEY for ask-ai reactions and a curly-braces deletion error.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 62-67: both causes and fixes are specified.

required_facts.fact: The repair finished while Alexey was preparing for a family trip and required no browser or AWS console interaction.
required_facts.evidence: Source lines 58-71: time constraint, completion, and operational context are stated.

author_attribution: Attribute the bot, its maintenance, and tool preferences to Alexey; preserve that the moderator remained untested and the repair had two identified causes.
